svg.title: Ending: The Edge of the World
svg.desc: Ending card, The Edge of the World: the bark above, the yard below. Above, Mossa at the top of Highridge at dawn looking to where the bark curves away, the scholars' stakes along it, and Fenn's map with the Shadow's five arms, an outer edge and an inner one. Below, the rise goes on over the yard, the fence and the next yards.
svg.text: They did not know what lay past the edge. They knew there was one.
